name: @allfantasy/widget-react
description: AllFantasy Widget SDK — React adapter: useAllFantasyWidget hook + WidgetRenderBoundary/AllFantasyWidget components (Phase 7.8/7.18). Consumes only the frozen lib/decision-os/sdk + lib/decision-os/presentation/widget-contracts contracts, plus the framework-agnostic runtime core (PHASE_7_5_WIDGET_RUNTIME_BOUNDARY_ADR.md).
